title: W Controls Interview
eyebrow: GUI.Forms · stage W · Windows Forms controls · interview round 1
lede: Four calls hold the next Windows Forms controls. The survey is planning/stages/W-winforms-controls/README.md (PR #319). Your answers are kept in this browser; save them to a file or copy the record back to the coordinating session.
context_html:
Where W stands

Of the 93 Windows Forms types surveyed, 68 are done, 18 partial and 7 missing. This batch adds OpenFileDialog (#327), SaveFileDialog (#330), FolderBrowserDialog, ColorDialog and DataGridViewImageColumn (#335). Dialogs are shown by the host, with no in-window fallback, and there are no public CommonDialog or FileDialog bases yet.
footer_html: They become owner decisions in planning/stages/W-winforms-controls/README.md, and the W worker builds the next controls.
